title: Project-style regression diagnosis
description: Cross-language comparison of agents diagnosing and repairing four multi-file regressions from read-only issue and test evidence.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-repository success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check repository success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict project-maintenance parity.

source_protocol.editable_files: The twelve language-specific seeded implementation files across four repositories.
source_protocol.read_only_files: Eight language-neutral ISSUE.md and tests/regression.txt artifacts, visibly marked read-only and byte-identical across languages.
source_protocol.public_examples: Protected by the checker and omitted from every agent prompt; diagnosis comes from source and read-only project evidence.
source_protocol.protected_files: Checker, source printer, configuration, prompt, public/hidden cases, and attempt log are never agent-readable and remain integrity-hashed.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.
The four regression families, source seeds, issue/test evidence, and all public/hidden cases were independently checked and committed before protocol freeze or any measured session.
Read-only context is byte-identical across languages; implementation syntax and ordinary standard-library setup remain language-specific.
The protected source-printer output becomes measured agent context through the model session; no source, issue text, test evidence, or public example is duplicated inline in the prompt.
Changed-file count and rough-token edit size are secondary maintenance metrics, not substitutes for hidden correctness or the four-condition gate.
This synthetic but diagnosis-shaped corpus is broader evidence than explicit prompt-level rewrites, not a claim about every real repository.
secondary_analysis: Report every session, repository outcome, repair, token count, elapsed time, prompt size, editable-source size, read-only-context size, edit size, changed-file count, integrity result, and command-protocol result.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by unrelated repository and independent session.
Audit whether agents locate and change the seeded defect rather than editing read-only evidence or unrelated helpers.
Compare the complete primary medians with repair-free sensitivity only if at least two Parley sessions pass all four repositories on their first check.
Inspect recurring diagnosis or language failures only after preserving the full result; a single task, transcript, or session cannot justify a compiler or skill change.
feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155 with the exact 1,519-character skill. Iteration 028 changes only the language-neutral harness capability and preregistered task shape: agents diagnose multi-file regressions from read-only repository evidence instead of explicit prompt examples.
change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from iteration 027 output unless a signature recurs across unrelated repositories and independent sessions, then passes general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability review.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. If strict parity passes, preregister a larger confirmation before claiming parity. If it fails, make no same-corpus syntax or instruction change; only independently recurring general defects may enter separate design review.
